desc: Verify edge-inclusion formulas: exactly-one probability is 2(i-1)/(i(i+1)) for i<u, (u-1)/u for i=u, 1/i for u<i<v, 1 for i=v, 0 for i>v; handle u=1.
Implement the full Python solution with precomputation and O(1) queries as described.
Test on provided samples and edge cases (N=2, u=1, v=u+1, large A_i) — all 3 public samples pass, plus brute-force checks in notes.
